quality_scope: Reuse established displacement, coverage and median-gradient bounds conservatively throughout this specific trajectory. The gradient bound is an additional campaign gate outside the previously qualified frame40; it is not a universal material-strain uncertainty claim. No bound is relaxed for a faster interpolator.
whole_grid: Retain all accepted errors, failures and iterations; reflected/deformed boundary failures are not relabeled as accurate measurements.
early_abort: Count would-converge-late raw status1 with an untimed no-abort solve using the identical image and retained seed; do not call it a production retry.
adaptive: Host feedback serializes outstanding work at every requested depth. Report actual levels per frame; depth2 adaptive is effectively depth1.
